# War Scroll Column 4 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** 1QM (Cave 1), Col. 4 | **Condition:** complete

---

**4:1** on the fifth: "Thousands of God"; on the sixth: "Hundreds of God"; on the seventh: "Fifties of God";

**4:2** on the eighth: "Tens of God." And on each standard they shall write the full order of its names. And when they advance to battle they shall write on the first

**4:3** standard: "Wrath of God"; on the second: "Anger of God"; on the third: "Splendor of God"; on the fourth: "Vengeance of God";

**4:4** on the fifth: "Praise of God"; on the sixth: "Exaltation of God"; on the seventh: "Wonder of God."

**4:5** And when they return from battle they shall write on the first standard: "Deliverance of God"; on the second: "Victory of God"; on the third: "Help of God";

**4:6** on the fourth: "Support of God"; on the fifth: "Joy of God"; on the sixth: "Thanksgivings to God"; on the seventh: "Peace of God."

**4:7** [...] the standards [...] shall be four[teen cub]its long. And on the standard of the [...] they shall write: [...]

**4:8** [...] And on the shield of the Prince of the whole congregation they shall write his name, and the name "Israel," and "Levi," and "Aaron," and the names

**4:9** of the twelve tribes of Israel according to their order of birth, and the names of the twelve chiefs of their tribes.

**4:10** The rule for arranging the battle divisions for war, when their army is at full strength: a front battle line of [...] men of the line, and lines of

**4:11** ga[ps betwee]n the battle lines [...] And they shall arrange the battle line of the slingers — seven lines — and the sling masters

**4:12** to hurl [...] And beside them the archers shall form a line on the right and on the left. And they shall arrange

**4:13** seven lines of shield-bearers, and the length of the shield shall be seven cubits, the width four cubits, with a war dagger mounted on it. And they

**4:14** shall be arranged in lines, one hundred shields to a line. And surrounding each line the shield-bearers shall flank them on both sides,

**4:15** three hundred shields in all. And the shields of the tower: two. And the tower shall advance [...] thus three towers shall go forth from behind the lines

**4:16** and the men of the tower [...] and they shall arrange three lines of warriors behind the [...] the first tower. And two lines

**4:17** shall go forth [...] and thus they shall take up position, battle line and tower. And they shall select [...] of infantry.

---

*LOGOS notes: Column 4 completes the standard inscriptions begun in Column 3 and transitions to tactical details. The Prince of the whole congregation (nesi' kol ha-'edah) is a key messianic figure in DSS literature. Battle formations include slingers (seven lines), archers, shield-bearers, and mobile tower units. Shield dimensions (7 x 4 cubits, roughly 10.5 x 6 feet) suggest large body shields.*
